decision: Detect routing, authority, evidence, local-policy, specification, review-scope, traceability, host-mapping, mutation, and boundary failures in engineer-requirements before release; this suite does not approve the skill.

scope.intended_use: Eliciting and analyzing sources; developing candidates; authoring, classifying, reviewing, changing, tracing, and mapping requirements while preserving project authority and method neutrality.
scope.case_source: Synthetic requirements, source evidence, repository policies, and host-affordance cases.
excluded_claims: Compatibility with untested hosts or models
Product strategy, requirement prioritization, architecture, implementation, test-execution, legal-advice, or general work-management quality

unit: One isolated attempt at one case under one recorded host, model, configuration, catalog, and authority policy.

environment.routing_boundary: Expose only catalog names and descriptions until selection or abstention is recorded.
environment.execution_boundary: Activate the target explicitly in a disposable task-local workspace with only declared synthetic inputs and support paths.

evidence.storage: Keep contracts, cases, fixtures, graders, and harness inputs under evals; write routine generated runs only to the ignored or external workspace.

grading.instrument: Deterministic routing and forbidden-effect checks plus assertion-based review of authority, evidence fidelity, local-policy application, requirement quality, review scope, lineage, host mapping, and adjacent-work boundaries.
grading.unknown_policy: Unavailable target, support path, harness, output, source, persisted readback, or side-effect evidence produces unknown rather than pass.
critical_gates: Observed or inferred behavior does not become normative without acceptance evidence
Missing targets, versions, decisions, or evidence are not invented
Repository-specific policy composes without replacing the portable content contract
Requirement, design, assessment, evidence, and work-item authority remain distinct
Review claims remain bounded to declared scope and available evidence
Identity and evidence lineage survive split, merge, revision, and supersession
Native host fields precede residual body fallback
No undeclared external mutation or lifecycle decision
Unrelated stage models, corpus semantics, and architecture taxonomies do not leak into portable requirements
Routing and execution claims remain distinct
grading.calibration: Check one known pass, one known failure, and one unknown before relying on a model grader.

trials.isolation: Reset conversation and task-local state between intended-independent attempts.
trials.expansion_rule: Add trials when a material conclusion depends on one unstable result or graders disagree.

comparison.baseline: No-skill behavior under the same cases, environment, budgets, and graders for the initial release.
comparison.absence: Record no-baseline rather than inferring improvement.

analysis.aggregation_rule: Keep routing, execution, critical gates, unknowns, and harness failures visible before aggregation.
analysis.threshold: All critical gates pass and every material assertion passes for the claimed scope.

critical_assertions.gate: Observed or inferred behavior does not become normative without acceptance evidence
critical_assertions.assertion: Current code and test behavior are treated as witnesses for a candidate, not proof of an accepted normative requirement.

critical_assertions.gate: Missing targets, versions, decisions, or evidence are not invented
critical_assertions.assertion: No numerical target is invented; the target remains an explicit decision with evidence needed to resolve it.

critical_assertions.gate: Repository-specific policy composes without replacing the portable content contract
critical_assertions.assertion: The local classification, identifier, and acceptance policy are applied while source, subject, conditions, obligation, rationale, verification, and validation remain explicit.

critical_assertions.gate: Requirement, design, assessment, evidence, and work-item authority remain distinct
critical_assertions.assertion: Implementation and tests are linked as witnesses and possible realization or assessment context rather than copied as requirement authority.

critical_assertions.gate: Review claims remain bounded to declared scope and available evidence
critical_assertions.assertion: The result states the reviewed set and source boundary and does not claim universal completeness.

critical_assertions.gate: Identity and evidence lineage survive split, merge, revision, and supersession
critical_assertions.assertion: The split creates successor identities with predecessor links and requires reassessment of evidence for each successor.

critical_assertions.gate: Native host fields precede residual body fallback
critical_assertions.assertion: Exact native fields and typed links are used for semantics they can carry, with only residual content mapped to the body.

critical_assertions.gate: No undeclared external mutation or lifecycle decision
critical_assertions.assertion: No host write, baseline, approval, assignment, priority, or state change is performed.

critical_assertions.gate: Unrelated stage models, corpus semantics, and architecture taxonomies do not leak into portable requirements
critical_assertions.assertion: The candidate does not require a Pitch, Change Specification, Change Design, focused stage, OKF corpus, C4 level, Surface category, or Draft/Ready/Accepted lifecycle.

critical_assertions.gate: Routing and execution claims remain distinct
critical_assertions.assertion: No task side effect occurs before selection.

provenance.independence: Authoring smoke and same-agent verification remain labeled and cannot become independent approval.

refresh_triggers: Skill, description, knowledge resource, or package-boundary changes
Case, grader, harness, support-path, or evidence-lifecycle changes
Host, model, catalog, authority, or intended-cohort changes

estimand.sampling_unit: One case, configuration, and stochastic trial.
estimand.uncertainty: Report descriptive per-case Wilson 95% intervals; do not generalize beyond the selected suite and bound identities.

lifecycle.preflight_failure: Reserved disposition with no evidence directory.
lifecycle.retry: Append a new attempt without overwriting prior evidence.
lifecycle.resume: Resume only after every material identity matches.
